values.note: Papio-Missouri River NRD, via its Set Your Sites walk-up page: the 10 electric/water sites are $30 a night; the 14 non-electric sites and a group area are $15.

fees.source: Set Your Sites availability, night of 2027-06-08 (Sites 15-24: price 30, 30/50 A, water; Sites 1-14 and 25: price 15, no hookups), read 2026-11-05

hookups.source: Set Your Sites site catalog (Sites 15-24: has30Amp, has50Amp, water true), read 2026-11-05

sites.source: Set Your Sites site catalog: 10 electric/water sites (15-24), listed lengths 49-81 ft; plus 14 non-electric sites (1-14, 23-35 ft, and site 7 at 60 ft) the NRD calls tent sites, and a group area (site 25), read 2026-11-05

values.note: Walk-up only: find an open site and pay on the Set Your Sites page (on-site QR code). Check-out 2 pm; leaving early forfeits the remaining nights.

booking.source: Set Your Sites (walkupEnabled true, reservationEnabled false; maxNights 7 on every site; disclaimer 'Check out time is 2pm. If you leave early you will forfeit your remaining fees paid.'), read 2026-11-05

note: Papio-Missouri River NRD recreation area on the Elkhorn River near Valley. Tent/group area, new bathrooms, playground, disc golf, river/canoe access. --Claude
summary: The NRD's Set Your Sites walk-up page confirms 10 electric/water sites (30/50 A) at $30, plus 14 $15 non-electric sites and a group area; walk-up only, 7-night limit. Riverview stands (pads ~100-120 m from the river across open, lightly treed grass). Pin OK. NRD page unread (Cloudflare).
flags: SEASON question (not changed): stored opens 04-01 / closes 11-01 (derived, note). Set Your Sites announcement says '🚨 Last Night of Camping for 2026 is October 29th 🚨' and every site was closed on 2026-11-10. Probably a one-year date, so I left the stored season.

FEES base: I used $30 because the $15 sites have no hookups and the NRD (by search summary) calls them tent sites. Set Your Sites lists them with lengths 23-35 ft (site 7 at 60 ft) and no tent-only marker, so a 23-ft motorhome may be allowed on them at $15. Unconfirmed; the NRD page is unread.

WEBSITE: stored https://www.papionrd.org/recreation/river-access/ is Cloudflare-blocked (403) and https://www.nrdnet.org/rec-area/elkhorn-crossing-recreation-area returns 404. The NRD's own page for the campground, as linked from its booking engine, is https://www.papionrd.org/camping/elkhorn-crossing/; the walk-up page is https://portal.setyoursites.com/reservations/elkhorn-crossing. Suggest replacing both stored URLs. apply.py doesn't write website.
PHONE: stored 402-444-6222 (the NRD main line) could not be checked; papionrd.org is unread.

WATERFRONT riverview stands: on NAIP (260 m frame) the paved herringbone RV pads and their end circle sit ~100-120 m north of the Elkhorn (channel ~100 m wide). Between them is open mowed grass with scattered single trees and no road. The access road runs down the west side to the boat ramp. The river should be visible through the trees, but it is too far for riverfront.
PIN OK: stored 41.36145,-96.30165 sits among the pads. Google's 41.3644,-96.3023 is the entrance at Bennington Rd, ~320 m north.
HOOKUPS: Set Your Sites marks sewer false on every site and shows no dump station. I left both sewer and facilities.dump (stored false, derived) alone; an engine's default false is not a statement.

NOTE CLEANED: dropped '10 RV sites with 30/50-amp electric and water hookups' (hookups, sites), 'No dump station' (facilities), 'FCFS - register at entrance kiosk, max 7 consecutive days' (booking; the kiosk has been replaced by pay-by-phone) and 'Open Apr 1 - Nov 1' (season). Also dropped the 'not NGPC' gloss.
